item.title: Google just gave us an accidental first look at Android's PC future
item.description:
📝 We’ve known for a while now that Google plans to replace Chrome OS with Aluminium OS, which merges Chrome OS and Android into a single computer-focused platform. The recordings show split-screen multitasking with two Chrome Dev windows being split 50:50. These Chrome windows show tabbed browsing along with an extension icon.
🔗 Read more: https://www.androidauthority.com/google-aluminium-os-first-look-bug-report-3635801/
